web.home.reach: Signed in as a viewer, the home page.

web.confirmDelete.reach: Any dialog asking whether to delete something, such as deleting a download from the Downloads panel.

common.cancel.usage: Closes a dialog or form without doing what it asked about.

common.close.usage: Closes a dialog or panel that has nothing to confirm.

common.delete.usage: Deletes something, or confirms deleting it in a dialog that has just asked.

common.save.usage: Saves the changes made in a form or dialog.

common.tryAgain.usage: Repeats something that failed, such as loading a page.

common.search.usage: Names the search tool, or the field somebody types a search into.

common.loading.usage: Read out by screen readers while something is being fetched.

common.valence.usage: The product's name. Normally left untranslated.

common.episodesLeft.one.usage: On a programme's card: how many episodes this viewer has still to watch, when that is one.

common.episodesLeft.other.usage: On a programme's card: how many episodes this viewer has still to watch.

common.nothingMatches.usage: Shown in place of results when a search finds nothing. {query} is what was typed.
